domains.domainPddl:
(define (domain ferry)
  (:requirements :typing)
  (:types
    location car ferry
  )
  (:predicates
    (at ?obj - (either car ferry) ?loc - location)
    (on ?c - car ?f - ferry)
    (empty ?f - ferry)
  )

  (:action board
    :parameters (?c - car ?f - ferry ?loc - location)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?c ?loc)
      (at ?f ?loc)
      (empty ?f)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?c ?loc))
      (not (empty ?f))
      (on ?c ?f)
    )
  )

  (:action debark
    :parameters (?c - car ?f - ferry ?loc - location)
    :precondition (and
      (on ?c ?f)
      (at ?f ?loc)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on ?c ?f))
      (empty ?f)
      (at ?c ?loc)
    )
  )

  (:action sail
    :parameters (?f - ferry ?from - location ?to - location)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?f ?from)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?f ?from))
      (at ?f ?to)
    )
  )
)
